stem: $X$ is a random variable with distribution $\text{B}(10, 0.2)$. A random sample of 160 values of $X$ is taken.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the approximate distribution of the sample mean, including the values of the parameters.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Hence find the probability that the sample mean is less than 1.8.
